name: Who you know here
summary: The people going to an event drawn as a night sky: your friends are bright stars wired to the people they know, and you can ask one to introduce you.
useWhen: a big event where you only know a few of the people going
'who do I even know at this', 'is anyone I know going', 'can someone introduce me'
dontUseWhen: getting your friends to commit to going (use squad-lock)
a small plan where everyone knows each other
seats or tickets (use concert or ticket-split)

params.title: string
params.show: how to call the event in copy, e.g. the show
params.knows: {name, people: string[]}[]: who each friend knows there
